description: Returns one product's full test-drive result: how far an agent gets with it and where it stops (search_tools gives the slug; an unknown slug is an error that says how to find one): the agent level, the five outcomes (find, access, use, pay, leave, by any way in the product offers; stages: the four that decide the level, under their older keys), how an agent gets in (access, with the core tasks done on each way), the part scores, the nine checkpoints in the order of the agent's eight steps (Find: none, it is the Agent-ready setup; Learn: docs; Sign up: sign-up, verify; Get a key: key, first call; Do the work: first action; Pay: pay; Cancel: cancel; Leave: delete), what an agent can and cannot do, tips for agents, pay_options (the ways to pay it offers an agent, the payment our side proved with its transaction, and what the owner could add), the bot check that stopped our agent on a way in, even where it got in another way (agent_check: vendor, step, type network or challenge, the owner's fix), after_wall: what the agent did on its own once a person cleared one step at the door (never part of the level), works_assisted (the core tasks done once a person set up the account; null: not measured yet), robots (a robots.txt rule on the way in: named, the product's wall, or star, a rule for crawlers; held: the level is from the last drive past it), same_level_drives of drives, the level history with why each move happened (product, rules, noise), rules_date: the date of the rules the level was set by, audited: its certificate, if any (state, level, dates). From the rules of 12 Oct 2026 on: routes (every way in it offers and what happened on each, tried agent-native first), checkout (how far the walk to the last click went and what the checkout showed), docs (its docs read and judged) and claims (the documented ways to do the core work, tried once each: held, broken, worked but undocumented).

slug.description: The product's directory slug, from search_tools (e.g. 'attio')

name: get_tool
title: Get one tool's drive result
